thread:
Jordan M: FYI ran into a mypy/pyright cascade from the autogen pyi: optional defaults dropped + async stream signatures wrong. reproducible in examples/async_streams.py.

Priya N: can you paste the exact errors?

Jordan M: sure. mypy: `Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type \"List[str] | None\", variable has type \"list[str]\")` — occurs because runtime pydantic model has `tags: list[str] | None = None` but pyi has `tags: list[str]`. pyright: `Type mismatch: AsyncIterator is not compatible with Iterator` from a streaming call where stub used Iterator.

Omar R: two separate generator bugs then: (1) default None/default_factory -> lose Optional, (2) async defs emit Iterator not AsyncIterator.

Jordan M: yep. quick repro snippets in the thread:
```py
# runtime model (generated)
class Item(BaseModel):
    tags: list[str] | None = None
    meta: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)

# pyi produced
class Item(BaseModel):
    tags: list[str]
    meta: dict[str, Any]
```
and streaming stub: `async def subscribe(...) -> Iterator[Item]: ...`

Priya N: for meta (default_factory) pydantic guarantees a value post-init but callers sometimes set None explicitly. i'd prefer conservative Optional for default_factory too, else users hit surprises.

Omar R: agree with conservative approach: emit `T | None` for fields with default is None OR has default_factory. Safer for strict typing.

Jordan M: also ensure we import Optional in pyi when used. small patch fixes both and adds tests.

Priya N: about async iterator, generator should detect `is_async` on functions and change Iterator -> AsyncIterator + add the typing import. This slipped because we shared a template for sync/async streaming.

typecheck-bot: NOTE: created issue tools/autogen#402 \"stubs: preserve Optional for None/default_factory fields and use AsyncIterator for async streaming APIs\"

Jordan M: opened draft PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/tools/pull/789 with changes and a couple new tests: one runs mypy --strict on examples/typing_repro.py and the other runs pyright in strict mode. CI shows failures before fix.

CI Bot: ci/circle 1: lint-types failed on branch with pyright/mypy errors (https://ci.internal/789) :x:

Omar R: plan: update emission logic in tools/autogen/schema_to_stub.py: when field.default is None or field.has_default_factory -> wrap type in Optional[]. When emitting function stubs: if func.is_async -> use AsyncIterator. Add imports as needed.

Priya N: also add integration lint job: run both mypy and pyright on the sampleapp in the autogen PR pipeline. we've seen these two drift.

Jordan M: tiny workaround for customers: pip install wheel from PR artifacts or temporarily disable strict typing until patch propagates. i'll add a note in the PR description.

Omar R: can someone pick the follow-up to backport to the SDK template generator and update the release notes? this affects onboarding so we should include in the next patch release.

Priya N: i'll backport once PR is merged and open a release task. adding changelog entry: \"Fix: ensure Optional in stubs for None/default_factory fields; use AsyncIterator for async streaming APIs\".

Jordan M: thanks all. i'll push a small repro file into examples/repros and re-run CI once tests added. ping me for validation. :thumbsup:
